meta.name: abstraction-to-design
meta.description: Abstract biological principle to design principle. Bridge from biology to engineering.

copy.tagline: 将生物原理转化为设计灵感
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做设计时想从自然界找灵感
copy.tagline_en: Turn biological principles into design inspiration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you seek design inspiration from nature

howto.what: 当用户提供一个生物学策略（biological_strategy）时，Claude 会启动一个子智能体，将该生物学原理抽象为通用的设计原理，移除生物细节但保留功能本质，以应用于工程设计。
howto.when: 当用户要求将生物学原理转化为设计原理，或直接提供生物学策略字符串时触发。

say.text: 将捕蝇草的闭合机制抽象为机械设计原理。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的设计原理说明。

say.text: 抽象光合作用的光捕获结构为材料工程原理。
say.note: Claude 会输出工程可用的设计指南。

howto.what_en: When a user provides a biological strategy, Claude spawns a subagent to abstract the biological principle into a design principle by removing biological specifics while preserving functional essence, for engineering application.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to abstract a biological principle into a design principle, or provides a biological strategy string.

say_en.text: Abstract the closing mechanism of Venus flytrap into a mechanical design principle.
say_en.note: Claude will output a corresponding design principle.

say_en.text: Abstract the light-capturing structure of photosynthesis into a material engineering principle.
say_en.note: Claude will produce engineering-ready design guidance.
